name: workflow_update
description:
Replace an existing workflow entirely with a new definition. This is a full replace — every field is overwritten with the new value; there is no patch/merge.

Always call workflow_get first to read the current state before making changes.
The workflow.id inside the JSON must match the id parameter.

The workflow JSON schema is identical to what workflow_create accepts — see that tool's description for the full node type reference, variable reference syntax, and edge routing rules.

id.description: ID of the workflow to update (must already exist)

workflow.description: Complete replacement workflow JSON. All fields are overwritten. See workflow_create for the full schema including all four node types (parameters, prompt, tool, decide), variable references, and edge routing.
